stp.text: Lc 2:41-52 — Baꞌ gu gɨꞌkorgaꞌn gu Jesuus muiꞌ pu jimmɨdaꞌ am bhammɨ Jerusaleen nabap oidhaꞌ na paiꞌ dhuuk jum aajidhaꞌ bhaan Paaskua taꞌm.

en.text: Lc 5:1-11 — On one occasion, while Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret with the crowd pressing in on Him to hear the word of God,

es.text: Lc 5:1-11 — Boga mar adentro, y echad vuestras redes para pescar.

stp.text: Lc 5:1-11 — Baꞌ mummɨ jaꞌk Genesareet jup ba tu ja aꞌgiꞌñ gu Jesuus gu jaꞌtkam, juꞌñdharam gu gɇꞌ suudaiꞌ Galilea kam. Giilhim muiꞌ mim jumaap jamɨt gu jaꞌtkam nam jix kaim na jax tu aꞌga gu ñioꞌkiꞌñ gu Dios, ba kiꞌsap pɨx baꞌ.

en.text: Lc 7:11-17 — Soon afterward, Jesus went to a town called Nain. His disciples went with Him, accompanied by a large crowd.

es.text: Lc 7:11-17 — Joven, a ti te digo, levántate.

stp.text: Lc 7:11-17 — Baꞌ miꞌ dhɨr mu jaꞌk pu bhɨi gu Jesuus maaꞌn kap na paiꞌ Naiin tɨ tɨɨꞌ, bɨɨx jiim am sia guiꞌ nam kaichuꞌ gio jaiꞌ muiꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

en.text: Lc 10:25-37 — One day an expert in the law stood up to test Him. “Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”

es.text: Lc 10:25-37 — ¿Quién, pues, de estos tres te parece que fue el prójimo?

stp.text: Lc 10:25-37 — Baꞌ maadɨt guiꞌ nam sap jix mat kaꞌ gu ñioꞌkiꞌñ gu Dios mu jimɨɨk bhaiꞌ ba tɨkka gu Jesuus, na miꞌ pɨx jix maachim noꞌ sap moo puiꞌ pɨx jup ji bua na jax ɨlhiiꞌñ dɨɨlh. Jup tɨtda:―Jiñ jaduuñ, aañ jaꞌp tuꞌm bham tɨkkam nap iam jiñ aagiꞌñdhaꞌ gɨt nañ jaꞌp tɇ kɇɇ nap bɨxchuꞌ pɨx jix maat. ¿Tuꞌñ jax dhuñiaꞌ nañ baꞌ gammɨjɨ buiñor bap tuiꞌkaꞌ gu Dios?

en.text: Lc 10:38-42 — As they traveled along, Jesus entered a village where a woman named Martha welcomed Him into her home.

es.text: Lc 10:38-42 — María ha escogido la buena parte, la cual no le será quitada.

stp.text: Lc 10:38-42 — Baꞌ puiꞌ xi chu aꞌgidhat jimchuꞌ gu Jesuus. Nammɨ gama jaꞌk maaꞌn kap ba ai na paiꞌ jumai jɨꞌdɨlh jup jir kikcham. Baꞌ maaꞌn miꞌ kiokaꞌ gu ubii Maarta tɨɨgim, joidham cham jax ji chɨꞌɨɨk aich na sap miꞌ xi chɨbiapui.

plates.gesture: El padre corre. El mayor no entra.

en.text: Lc 15:11-32 — Then Jesus said, “There was a man who had two sons.”

es.text: Lc 15:11-32 — Este mi hijo muerto era, y ha revivido; se había perdido, y es hallado.

stp.text: Lc 15:11-32 — Baꞌ jumai bhaan jup ji chu uaꞌrgidhak muiꞌ ji chu ja aꞌgi gu Jesuus gu jaꞌtkam, jup ja tɨtda:―Maaꞌnnim maaꞌn gu maaꞌnkam gook tu maamar kaꞌ biipibop.

en.text: Lc 17:11-19 — While Jesus was on His way to Jerusalem, He was passing between Samaria and Galilee.

es.text: Lc 17:11-19 — ¿No son diez los que fueron limpiados? Y los nueve, ¿dónde están?

stp.text: Lc 17:11-19 — Baꞌ gu Jesuus na Jerusaleen jaꞌk jim, mi jaꞌp aꞌjim na paiꞌ jax Galilea bhaan bipioꞌ gu dɨbɨɨr gio na paiꞌ jax Samaaria bhaan jup bipioꞌ.

en.text: Lc 19:1-10 — Then Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.

es.text: Lc 19:1-10 — Zaqueo, date prisa, desciende, porque hoy es necesario que pose yo en tu casa.

stp.text: Lc 19:1-10 — Baꞌ miꞌ ba ai gu Jesuus na paiꞌ Jerikoo tɨ tɨɨꞌ, muiꞌ ji bhɨi ɨrban na paiꞌr kikcham.

en.text: Lc 21:1-4 — Then Jesus looked up and saw the rich putting their gifts into the treasury,

es.text: Lc 21:1-4 — Esta viuda pobre echó más que todos.

stp.text: Lc 21:1-4 — Baꞌ jaꞌxpɨx miꞌ jaꞌk jup ba ja nɨiꞌñ gu Jesuus gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ nam jir jix chutumñigam, nam pɨx miꞌ ji chuꞌaim gu tuumiñ miꞌ na paiꞌm tuaꞌba nam maakim gu Dios na jɨꞌk bhaan jup bipioꞌ. Muiꞌ miꞌ xi chuꞌaim am.

en.text: Lc 23:32-43 — Two others, who were criminals, were also led away to be executed with Jesus.

es.text: Lc 23:32-43 — De cierto te digo que hoy estarás conmigo en el paraíso.

stp.text: Lc 23:32-43 — Baꞌ gook pup muiꞌp ja uaꞌ am gu jaꞌtkam nam puiꞌp ja sissapaꞌ maap gu Jesuus kukrus taꞌm. Dhi gook jaꞌtkam ɨɨxdharaꞌ kɨꞌn ja koodaꞌ am.

plates.gesture: Pan partido. Se les abren los ojos.

en.text: Lc 24:13-35 — That same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.

es.text: Lc 24:13-35 — Y tomó el pan y lo bendijo, lo partió, y les dio.

stp.text: Lc 24:13-35 — Baꞌ pu guiꞌ gu tanoolh chaꞌm mu jaꞌk jup ka jiim am Emauus gook guiꞌ nam kaichuꞌ gu Jesuus, tɨi pup chix dhaam ji dhuñiidhak jum aꞌjɨ bhaiꞌ dhɨr Jerusaleen.

en.text: Jn 1:29-42 — The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!”

es.text: Jn 1:29-42 — Miren el Cordero de Dios, que quita el pecado del mundo.

stp.text: Jn 1:29-42 — Baꞌ buimgidhak miꞌ ba ai gu Jesuus na paiꞌ ja bopkon suudaiꞌ kɨꞌn gu jaꞌtkam gu Juan. Baꞌ nat ba tɨɨ gu Juan na muiꞌ ba jim gu Jesuus, jup ja tɨtda gu jaꞌtkam:―Dhiꞌñir diꞌ na muni dhɨr bhaiꞌ ba jim guiꞌ nat Dios bha joot nach aꞌmkam mukiaꞌ bɨɨx na jɨꞌk jaꞌtkam yaꞌ dhi oiꞌñgaꞌn, na baꞌ puꞌñi dhuuji tu namkix kaꞌ guch uaꞌtulhdharaꞌ. Dhiꞌ puiꞌ ji buusan na jax maaꞌn gux kɨɨꞌ kasnir, na guꞌm makgartaꞌ gatuuk.

en.text: Jn 2:1-11 — On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus' mother was there,

es.text: Jn 2:1-11 — Hagan todo lo que él les diga.

stp.text: Jn 2:1-11 — Baꞌ miꞌ dhɨr baik jurniꞌñ kɨꞌn dhiꞌ puiꞌ, mam tɨɨmo maaꞌn gu maaꞌnkam bɨɨmaꞌn gu tɨyaa mu Kanaa, na paiꞌ Galilea bhaan bipioꞌ guiꞌ gu dɨbɨɨr. Baꞌ bɨɨx mup oirɨ gu dɨꞌɨɨꞌn gu Jesuus

en.text: Jn 4:1-26 — When Jesus realized that the Pharisees were aware He was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John

es.text: Jn 4:1-26 — El que bebiere del agua que yo le daré, no tendrá sed jamás.

stp.text: Jn 4:1-26 — Baꞌ ba maat gu Jesuus nam puiꞌ ba tɇ kɇɇ guiꞌ nam pariseos jum tɨɨtɨꞌndaꞌ na amuub oirɨ, sap jup kaiꞌchdhaꞌ am gu jaꞌtkam: “Puiꞌp ba ja bopkon gu Jesuus gu jaꞌtkam, dai guiꞌ pɨx jam baꞌ mu jaꞌk ba kaichuꞌ bɨɨx, gu Juan miꞌ pɨx jaꞌp ji biꞌiim.”

en.text: Jn 5:1-9 — Some time later there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

es.text: Jn 5:1-9 — Levántate, toma tu camilla, y anda.

stp.text: Jn 5:1-9 — Baꞌ mɨkkat giop ma jii gu Jesuus bhammɨ jaꞌk Jerusaleen, nat guꞌ bam ai nam paiꞌ dhuuk tu piastat gu Israel kam jaꞌtkam.

en.text: Jn 6:1-14 — After this, Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias).

es.text: Jn 6:1-14 — Aquí está un muchacho, que tiene cinco panes de cebada y dos pececillos.

stp.text: Jn 6:1-14 — Baꞌ gatuuk na puiꞌ jɨꞌ xi chu aꞌgimɨk gu Jesuus, ma jii baasɨꞌn dɨr jaꞌk nam paiꞌ gook kɨꞌn jix chu mat kaꞌ, suudaiꞌ gɇꞌ suuꞌn na Galilea bhaan bipioꞌ, gio baꞌ suudaiꞌ gɇꞌ suuꞌn na Tibeeriyas bhaan bipioꞌ.

en.text: Jn 9:1-12 — Now as Jesus was passing by, He saw a man blind from birth,

es.text: Jn 9:1-12 — Fue entonces, y se lavó, y regresó viendo.

stp.text: Jn 9:1-12 — Baꞌ nammɨ gama jaꞌk na ba jimchuꞌ gu Jesuus, ba tɨɨ maaꞌn gu maaꞌnkam cham ñia kam na mi jaꞌp daa, na dɨɨlh pur pu chuꞌm nat dɨr maaxir.

en.text: Jn 10:1-16 — “Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.”

es.text: Jn 10:1-16 — Yo soy el buen pastor; el buen pastor su vida da por las ovejas.

stp.text: Jn 10:1-16 — Baꞌp ja tɨtda gu Jesuus:―Tuꞌ sɨlhkam jañ yaꞌ pu jam tɨɨdaꞌñ jaaduñ, gu jaroiꞌ noꞌt cham miꞌ dhɨr mu baa na paiꞌ kiidhaꞌ gu ja chikiir gu kakasnir, noꞌt guꞌ jaꞌp dɨr jaꞌk mu baa, dhiꞌr diꞌ kaꞌ gux ɨxkum na miꞌx chɨ ɨɨxdham kaꞌ gu kakasnir nam mi kuup.

en.text: Jn 11:38-44 — Jesus, once again deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.

es.text: Jn 11:38-44 — ¡Lázaro, ven fuera!

stp.text: Jn 11:38-44 — Baꞌr jix moik aiꞌ dɨꞌn kɨr bhɨjɨ na mɨt paiꞌ yaas gu Laasar, jodai komaarak baꞌ kɨꞌn bha kuup. Baꞌx ioꞌm miaꞌn muiꞌ xi ai gu Jesuus bhaiꞌ na paiꞌ yaasap gu mukdhaꞌ, sia puiꞌ ji ñakgat nax buam tu tatdaꞌ,

en.text: Jn 12:1-8 — Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, the hometown of Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.

es.text: Jn 12:1-8 — Y la casa se llenó del olor del perfume.

stp.text: Jn 12:1-8 — Baꞌ na xijum maaꞌn tanoolh pɨx ba biꞌchuꞌ na baꞌ moo bam aayaꞌ gu bhaan Paaskua taꞌm, muiꞌ ma jii gu Jesuus bhammɨ Betaania na paiꞌ kio gu Laasar guiꞌ nat duaꞌñdhak giop bamiiꞌ na ba muukix kat.

en.text: Jn 13:1-15 — It was now just before the Passover Feast, and Jesus knew that His hour had come to leave this world and return to the Father. Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the very end.

es.text: Jn 13:1-15 — Pues si yo, el Señor y el Maestro, he lavado los pies a ustedes, ustedes también deben lavarse los pies unos a otros.

stp.text: Jn 13:1-15 — Baꞌ takaab dɨr na baꞌ moo bam aayaꞌ gu bhaan Paaskua taꞌm nam paiꞌ dhuuk tu piastatdaꞌ gu Israel kam jaꞌtkam, pux bhaiꞌ bax maat gu Jesuus nat bam ai na paiꞌ dhuuk giop ba jimiaꞌx dhaam buiñor guch Gɨꞌkoraꞌ nat paiꞌ dhɨr bha jii. Cham jax bua sia ku mɨt dɨɨlh yaꞌ ji bii guiꞌ nam jɨꞌk kaichuꞌ, na guꞌ puiꞌ na jax jix ja joiꞌndat bax ja daꞌdaꞌ sia kut ba jii nat jax jix ja joiꞌgɨlh yaꞌ dhi oiꞌñgaꞌn na ja bɨɨm oilhimɨk.

en.text: Jn 19:1-5 — Then Pilate took Jesus and had Him flogged.

es.text: Jn 19:1-5 — ¡Miren el hombre!

stp.text: Jn 19:1-5 — Baꞌ gux kaiꞌ Pilaato puiꞌ ma tu chia nam gɨɨꞌbiaꞌ gu Jesuus.

en.text: Jn 20:11-18 — But Mary stood outside the tomb weeping. And as she wept, she bent down to look into the tomb,

es.text: Jn 20:11-18 — ¡Raboni! (que quiere decir, Maestro).

stp.text: Jn 20:11-18 — Guꞌ baꞌ gu Mariiya Magdaleena dɨɨlh miꞌ ji biꞌɨɨk suaak mi jaꞌp kɨɨkat nax buam jum aaꞌ na cham tu jaiꞌch gu tukgaꞌn gu Jesuus. Gu Peegro guꞌ ba jii gio gu jumai nam maap jiim. Baꞌ miꞌ puiꞌ na ji suakɨt gu Mariiya gio bhɨjɨp ka xi chɨ tɨɨ dɨꞌn kɨr dumaalh jum tɨkaak.

plates.gesture: Red a la derecha. Fuego en la orilla.

en.text: Jn 21:1-14 — Later, by the Sea of Tiberias, Jesus again revealed Himself to the disciples. He made Himself known in this way:

es.text: Jn 21:1-14 — Echad la red a la derecha de la barca, y hallaréis.

stp.text: Jn 21:1-14 — Baꞌ gatuuk jɨꞌkchi tanoolh jurniꞌñ kɨꞌn gio mummɨp bam maax gu Jesuus ja bui xijum gook guiꞌ nam kaichuꞌ, mummu juꞌñdharan gu gɇꞌ suudaiꞌ na Tibeeriyas tɨ tɨɨꞌ. Jaꞌpnim duu.

project: Evangelios para Colorear (Programa del Año - 52 Hojas)
